lines.en: label yasuspecial15:
scene yasugenres1
It’s a completely normal and peaceful day in my office.
lines.zh: 我办公室里是完全正常、平静的一天。

lines.en: scene yasugenres2
Nevermind.
lines.zh: 当我没说。

lines.en: : Sir!
lines.zh: : 先生！

lines.en: : What, Molly?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Molly？

lines.en: : The three of us require your assistance! Or...guidance! Or something!
lines.zh: : 我们三个需要你的协助！或者……指导！或者什么的！

lines.en: : Why? Aren’t you supposed to be at your club right now?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你们现在不是该在社团活动吗？

lines.en: : This actually...is our club activity for the day. We’re teaching Yasu about manga.
lines.zh: : 这个其实……就是我们今天的社团活动。我们在教 Yasu 漫画。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Just so we’re all on the same page here, you guys know I that I am pretty much entirely unfamiliar with manga, right?
lines.zh: : 先确认一下我们看法一致——你们知道我基本上对漫画一窍不通吧？

lines.en: : Aye!
: And that asking me for help with this is essentially pointless because of that.
lines.zh: : 也知道因为这个，找我帮忙基本没意义。

lines.en: : Aye!
: Okay, cool. I just wanted to make sure.
lines.zh: : 好，很好。我就是想确认一下。

lines.en: : So...you’ll come with us, then?
lines.zh: : 那么……你会跟我们一起来咯？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. Why not leave my involvement up to Yasu? You know, since her new thing is apparently just ghosting on me without a care in the world.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。干嘛不把「我参不参与」交给 Yasu 决定？毕竟她现在的新爱好显然就是毫无顾忌地人间蒸发、把我晾在一边。

lines.en: scene yasugenres3
: Ghost?
lines.zh: : 蒸发？

lines.en: : Oof. That sort of crit would take most other people out in one shot, Sir. I’m surprised you’re still able to stand up after that.
lines.zh: : 哦豁。这种暴击换别人一下就倒了，先生。你挨了这一下还能站着，我挺意外的。

lines.en: : You and...Yasu have been spending time together?
lines.zh: : 你和……Yasu 一直有在一起？

lines.en: : If by spending time with her you mean her offering me eggs and then immediately leaving in the middle of conversations, yes.
lines.zh: : 如果你说的「跟她在一起」是指她递给我几个鸡蛋、然后话说到一半就走人，那是的。

lines.en: : That’s not...really what I meant, no.
lines.zh: : 那……真不是我想说的意思。

lines.en: scene yasugenres4
: I’m sorry, but...I don’t remember this at all.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，可是……我完全不记得这个。

lines.en: : You don’t remember having a “summer celebration” with a bunch of rabbit dolls in that weird cathedral and drinking tea made from back alley leaf litter?
lines.zh: : 你不记得我们在那座奇怪的教堂里、跟一堆兔子玩偶开「夏日庆典」，还喝了用后巷落叶泡的茶？

lines.en: : I remember the celebration, but I don’t remember your presence.
lines.zh: : 我记得那场庆典，但不记得你在场。

lines.en: : Which made me very sad since I brewed extra tea for you.
lines.zh: : 这让我很难过，因为我特意为你多泡了茶。

lines.en: scene yasugenres5
: Wait...you...drank tea made of leaves you found on the ground?
lines.zh: : 等等……你们……喝了用地上捡的叶子泡的茶？

lines.en: : Special leaves that the one with many eyes blew onto the sacred asphalt behind the place He falls asleep at night.
lines.zh: : 是特别的叶子——是那个长着许多眼睛的存在，吹到祂夜里安睡之处后面那条神圣柏油路上的叶子。

lines.en: : Are we going to ignore the “party with rabbit dolls” part? Or is that something we just expect out of her ghostliness at this point?
lines.zh: : 我们要不要先不管「跟兔子玩偶开派对」那部分？还是说到这地步，我们已经默认她那股幽灵感会干出这种事了？

lines.en: : Wait, Yasu- do you really not remember me being there?
lines.zh: : 等等，Yasu——你真不记得我在那儿吗？

lines.en: scene yasugenres6
: I waited so long for you that Touka sent one of her fancy cars to come pick me up so I wouldn’t have to walk home during what she called the “witching hour.”
lines.zh: : 我等了你那么久，最后 Touka 派了她一辆高级车来接我，好让我不用在她所谓的「巫时」走回家。

lines.en: : Now, you’ll have to wait until next summer for divine protection.
lines.zh: : 现在，你得等到明年夏天才能得到神圣庇佑了。

lines.en: : Or just find yourself a paladin. Which, not gonna lie, is far easier said than done, Sir.
lines.zh: : 或者干脆给自己找个圣骑士。不过说实话，那说起来容易做起来难，先生。

lines.en: : I’ll be fine without “divine protection.” What I’m more concerned about is the fact that I now have memories of a thing that apparently never happened.
lines.zh: : 没有「神圣庇佑」我也死不了。我更在意的是：我现在竟然拥有一段显然从未发生过的记忆。

lines.en: : Perhaps this is just some sort of dream you’re remembering, Sir? Yasu doesn’t seem like the type to cast vanish in the middle of casual conversation.
lines.zh: : 也许这只是你记起来的某种梦，先生？Yasu 看起来不像会在闲聊中途施「消失术」的那种人。

lines.en: : Maybe. It’s just weird that I’d also remember the names of her stuffed rabbits.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。只是我还记得她那些毛绒兔子的名字，这有点怪。

lines.en: scene yasugenres7
: The rabbits do not belong to me. They belong to everyone.
lines.zh: : 那些兔子不属于我。它们属于所有人。

lines.en: : They are His ears...and carry forth the whispers too soft for Him to hear on His own.
lines.zh: : 它们是祂的耳朵……传递那些太轻、祂自己听不见的低语。

lines.en: : All shapes and all sizes.
lines.zh: : 各种形状，各种大小。

lines.en: : All forms and all colors.
lines.zh: : 各种形态，各种颜色。

lines.en: scene yasugenres8
: Except red.
lines.zh: : 除了红色。

lines.en: : Red is bad.
lines.zh: : 红色不好。

lines.en: : I take great offense to this.
lines.zh: : 我对此深感不快。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t really remember what colors or sizes they were...but does the name “Wormwood” ring a bell?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我其实不记得它们是什么颜色、什么大小了……不过「Wormwood」这个名字你有印象吗？

lines.en: scene yasugenres9
: Aye! That’s a card from the World of Warcraft TCG that allows you to put a target ally into-
lines.zh: : 有！那是魔兽世界卡牌里的一张牌，可以让你把目标友方放入——

lines.en: : Yes! Wormwood is an emissary! One who carries all sorts of information about the history of the church!
lines.zh: : 对！Wormwood 是一位使者！他传递关于教会历史的各种信息！

lines.en: : Yeah! Or that!
lines.zh: : 对！或者那个也行！

lines.en: : I am glad you remember him!
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你记得他！

lines.en: scene yasugenres10
: But I don’t understand how that would be possible. He only appears to me on special occasions and you were not at the celebration.
lines.zh: : 可我不明白那怎么可能。他只在特殊场合出现在我面前，而你根本没参加那场庆典。

lines.en: : I’m telling you I was, though...
lines.zh: : 可我告诉你我参加了啊……

lines.en: : Did you drink the tea?
lines.zh: : 你喝茶了吗？

lines.en: : No. I-
lines.zh: : 没有。我——

lines.en: : You should have drank the tea. It is possible your body was detached from your mind as a result of your failure to do so.
lines.zh: : 你该喝那茶的。有可能因为你没喝，你的身体脱离了你的心智。

lines.en: Or it’s possible that Yasu is insane and simply doesn’t remember the fact that we had an entire conversation about her god at a table full of stuffed animals.
lines.zh: 或者也有可能是 Yasu 疯了，单纯不记得我们曾在一张摆满毛绒玩具的桌子旁、就她的神进行过一整场对话。

lines.en: I guess that wouldn’t really explain the sudden vanishing of them, though...
lines.zh: 不过我猜那也解释不了它们怎么突然消失了……

lines.en: But it’s entirely possible I just lost track of time again. It obviously wouldn’t be the first time something like that happened.
lines.zh: 但完全有可能我又一次忘了时间。显然这种事不是第一次发生了。

lines.en: And it sure as hell makes a lot more sense than vanishing rabbits or the sudden introduction of “amnesia” to the list of mental issues Yasu likely needs to be professionally diagnosed with.
lines.zh: 而且那肯定比「兔子消失」、或者把「失忆」突然加进 Yasu 大概需要专业诊断的那串精神问题清单里，要说得通得多。

lines.en: I do feel a little better knowing that there was no conscious decision to ghost me, though.
lines.zh: 不过知道她不是故意要晾着我，我感觉好一点了。

lines.en: And I guess it’s fine to prioritize that over the idea of false memories because, let’s face it, I’ve become a bit of an expert when it comes to memory related issues.
lines.zh: 而且我想，把这看得比「虚假记忆」更重也没问题——因为说实话，在跟记忆有关的问题上，我已经算是半个专家了。

lines.en: Just don’t tell that to Maya or she’ll probably get sad and reflective.
lines.zh: 只是别告诉 Maya，不然她大概会难过、会开始反思。

lines.en: : Yasu...I really don’t think you should be making tea out of things you find on the ground...
lines.zh: : Yasu……我真觉得你不该拿地上捡的东西泡茶……

lines.en: scene yasugenres11
: You would change your mind if you had some. It is the cure for all things and would quell the sadness in your heart that eats away at your innards like carrion birds.
lines.zh: : 你要是喝过就不会这么说了。那是万物的解药，能平息你心底那份像食腐鸟一样啃食你内脏的悲伤。

lines.en: : The feeling you’re describing sounds...more like a virus you may have gotten from-
lines.zh: : 你描述的那种感觉听起来……更像是你从——得的某种病毒

lines.en: : Can we stop talking about carrion birds and tea leaves and get back to the topic at hand?
lines.zh: : 我们能别聊食腐鸟和茶叶，回到正题吗？

lines.en: : We’re here to enlist Sensei’s help for Yasu’s reeducation process, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们来这儿是为了拉老师入伙、帮 Yasu 完成「再教育」流程，对吧？

lines.en: : Reeducation process?
lines.zh: : 再教育流程？

lines.en: scene yasugenres12
: I am broken beyond repair and these two wonderful and helpful girls are going to help fix me.
lines.zh: : 我坏到修不好了，而这两位又棒又热心的女孩要帮我修好。

lines.en: : We’re not going to fix you, Yasu...We just want to help you figure out what type of manga you like since you’ve never read any and...have decided to join the manga club despite that.
lines.zh: : 我们不是要修好你，Yasu……我们只是想帮你搞清楚你喜欢哪类漫画——毕竟你一本都没读过，却……还是决定加入漫画社。

lines.en: : Shh. Stop. Don’t say anything that might make her question her decision. We need every member to stay in the club or we’ll all wind up in costumes at Sensei’s house.
lines.zh: : 嘘。停。别说任何可能让她质疑自己决定的话。我们需要每一个社员都留在社里，不然我们全得穿着戏服去老师家。

lines.en: : That sounds delightful.
lines.zh: : 听起来妙极了。

lines.en: scene yasugenres13
: No...that sounds very embarrassing...
lines.zh: : 不……那听起来非常丢人……

lines.en: : As supportive as I am of the idea of everyone coming over to my house and putting on cosplay, I still don’t understand how I am supposed to help Yasu figure out what kind of manga she likes.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很支持大家来我家、玩角色扮演这个主意，但我还是不明白，我该怎么帮 Yasu 搞清楚她喜欢哪类漫画。

lines.en: : Especially when I don’t even know what kind of manga I like.
lines.zh: : 尤其连我自己喜欢哪类漫画都不知道。

lines.en: : As the club advisor, that is probably something you should know, Sir.
lines.zh: : 作为社团顾问，这大概是您该知道的事，先生。

lines.en: : As the club president, you should be off doing your job instead of dragging me into it as well.
lines.zh: : 作为社长，你该去干你的活，而不是顺带把我拖下水。

lines.en: : But, Sir! If I’m not annoying you every hour of every day, what purpose do I even have?
lines.zh: : 可是，先生！如果我不每时每刻烦你，我活着还有什么意义？

lines.en: : Have you been talking to Io lately?
lines.zh: : 你最近跟 Io 聊过了？

lines.en: : Sir. No one has been talking to Io lately.
lines.zh: : 先生。最近没人跟 Io 聊过。

lines.en: : You know what? That’s fair.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？这话在理。

lines.en: : I like her hair. It reminds me of the grass.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢她的头发。让我想起草。

lines.en: scene yasugenres14
: Sensei...the reason we need your help is less of an actual need for help and more the fact that...Yasu seemed upset that you weren’t going to be at club.
lines.zh: : 老师……我们需要你帮忙，与其说是真的需要帮忙，不如说是因为……Yasu 似乎因为你不去社团而难过。

lines.en: : What? Really?
lines.zh: : 什么？真的？

lines.en: : Summer can only do so much for the sounds I hear. Having you nearby makes them even clearer.
lines.zh: : 夏天对我听到的声音只能起到那么点作用。你在附近，它们会变得更清晰。

lines.en: : Did you hear that, Sir? Are you really going to say no to a line as cute as that?
lines.zh: : 听到了吗，先生？这么可爱的一句话，你真要拒绝？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Strike that. Are you really going to say no to a line as cute as that knowing that Yasu will also be in cosplay?
lines.zh: : 收回。知道 Yasu 还会穿角色扮演服装，这么可爱的一句话，你真要拒绝？

lines.en: : In addition to wanting you there...Yasu was also upset that we weren’t dressing up today...
lines.zh: : 除了想让你在场……Yasu 还因为我们今天不换装而难过……

lines.en: : See, this is a detail that should have been revealed from the start. This changes everything.
lines.zh: : 瞧，这种细节早说不就完了。这改变了一切。

lines.en: : I hope that you are not repulsed by the sight of a worm in beautiful clothing.
lines.zh: : 希望你不会被一条穿着漂亮衣服的蠕虫的样子吓到。

lines.en: : If you are, just close your eyes. You need not see for me to feel your presence. But you must be present for me to see.
lines.zh: : 如果被吓到，闭上眼睛就好。你不需要看见，我也能感觉到你在。但你必须在场，我才能看见。

lines.en: : Do you see?
lines.zh: : 你明白吗？

lines.en: : No. But I’m not about to try and figure it out when I know that something much more interesting than this awaits in the club room.
lines.zh: : 不明白。不过既然我知道社团教室里有什么比这有意思得多的东西等着我，我也不打算去弄明白。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay. Everybody out. Come on.
lines.zh: : 好。各位出去。来吧。

lines.en: : Quest complete! Fantastic job, Yasu!
lines.zh: : 任务完成！干得漂亮，Yasu！

lines.en: : Remind me to come up with a nickname for you as soon as possible. You’ve earned it.
lines.zh: : 提醒我尽快给你想个外号。你配得上。

lines.en: : I have earned nothing but a life of servitude for-
lines.zh: : 我什么都没挣到，只挣到一辈子为人服役的——

lines.en: : Oh, look. We’re here...
lines.zh: : 噢，瞧。我们到了……

lines.en: scene yasugenres15
: Sensei...you can wait out here with me while Molly helps Yasu get changed...
lines.zh: : 老师……你可以在外面跟我一起等，让 Molly 帮 Yasu 换衣服……

lines.en: : I hope you like crimson demons, Sir. Because what you’re about to see is bound to make you explode.
lines.zh: : 希望你喜欢绯红恶魔，先生。因为你马上要看到的东西，绝对会让你爆炸。

lines.en: : Demon? But demons are bad. I don’t want to be a demon.
lines.zh: : 恶魔？可恶魔是坏的。我不想当恶魔。

lines.en: scene yasugenres16
: Well...the name is more of a technicality than anything. The character is basically just a fire mage.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那名字更多是个技术性说法。那角色基本上就是个火法。

lines.en: : But warlocks and mages are also enemies of God.
lines.zh: : 可术士和法师也是神的敌人。

lines.en: : Do you have anything with wings?
lines.zh: : 你们有带翅膀的吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...not on hand, no. But you’ll be fine. It’s just pretend, okay?
lines.zh: : 呃……手头没有。不过你没问题的。只是扮演而已，好吗？

lines.en: : Now, get in there and start stripping. We don’t want the Herald of the Adolescents waiting too long, do we?
lines.zh: : 现在，进去开始脱。我们可不想让「青春期先驱」等太久，对吧？

lines.en: scene black
Molly shoves Yasu into the club room and Futaba lets out a hearty sigh, showcasing just how exhausting the introduction of everyone’s favorite cult member to their friend group is.
lines.zh: Molly 把 Yasu 推进社团教室，Futaba 长长叹了口气——充分展示了把大家最爱的那位邪教成员介绍进朋友圈有多累人。

lines.en: She tells me a little about how she expected things to settle down after Rin left.
lines.zh: 她跟我讲了讲，她原本以为 Rin 走了之后事情就会安定下来。

lines.en: But apparently, having someone completely new to the nerd world around has awoken something in Molly that she is having trouble containing.
lines.zh: 但显然，身边多了个对宅文化完全陌生的人，唤醒了 Molly 心里某种她难以克制的东西。

lines.en: And while I’d like to talk about how I’m sure this is all just temporary and that Yasu will adjust and Molly will settle down in no time at all, both of those things are obviously untrue.
lines.zh: 虽然我想说我确信这一切都只是暂时的、Yasu 会适应、Molly 也很快就会消停——但这两件事显然都不成立。

lines.en: In fact, I can’t fathom any scenario where Yasu doesn’t stick out like a sore thumb.
lines.zh: 事实上，我想不出任何一种 Yasu 不会格格不入到扎眼的情境。

lines.en: But I’m glad she’s trying.
lines.zh: 不过我很高兴她在尝试。

lines.en: Even if her efforts are currently resulting in her being dragged around like a puppy on a leash by a small Irish girl.
lines.zh: 哪怕她目前的努力，正导致她被一个爱尔兰小女孩像遛狗一样用绳子牵着到处走。

lines.en: Even before that, though, Yasu was already on a leash.
lines.zh: 不过在那之前，Yasu 就已经戴着项圈了。

lines.en: She probably has been for a very long time now.
lines.zh: 而且大概已经戴了很久很久。

lines.en: We should be happy that we can see what this new one is attached to.
lines.zh: 我们该高兴的是：我们看得见这条新绳子拴在谁手上。

lines.en: scene yasugenres17
: Ta-dah! Yasumin!
lines.zh: : 当当！Yasumin！

lines.en: : And it only took me one night to adjust the costume for her size!
lines.zh: : 而且我只花了一晚就按她的尺寸改好了戏服！

lines.en: : Yasu! Say the line!
lines.zh: : Yasu！说那句台词！

lines.en: : Boom!
: Close enough!
lines.zh: : 差不多就行！

lines.en: : I’m not sure if it lives up to the one from the dorm wars, but I accept and appreciate this greatly and thank all of you for allowing me to be involved.
lines.zh: : 我不确定它比得上宿舍大战那次，但我接受、也非常感激，并谢谢你们所有人让我参与进来。

lines.en: : Don’t thank us, Sir! Thank Yasu for her ideal cosplay figure and extremely unique and only mildly creepy aesthetic.
lines.zh: : 别谢我们，先生！谢 Yasu 那理想的角色扮演身材，以及极其独特、只是稍微有点瘆人的气质。

lines.en: : Do I look like a real manga character now?
lines.zh: : 我现在看起来像个真的漫画角色了吗？

lines.en: : Sure. But with an extra dimension, which makes things even better.
lines.zh: : 当然。而且多了一个维度，这让事情更好。

lines.en: : Debatable!
lines.zh: : 这点有争议！

lines.en: scene yasugenres18
: So...have you thought at all about what genre you’d like to try first, Yasu?
lines.zh: : 那么……你想过先试哪种类型吗，Yasu？

lines.en: : We have all different types of books here. Ami and Maya even brought in most of their collection for you to sort through if you’d like.
lines.zh: : 我们这儿有各种各样的书。Ami 和 Maya 甚至把她们大部分收藏都带来了，你想翻就翻。

lines.en: : I don’t know if Yasu’s ready for any of the stuff Maya reads. PunPun isn’t really entrance level material unless you’re looking to an-hero.
lines.zh: : 我不确定 Yasu 准备好了看 Maya 读的那类东西。PunPun 真不是入门级材料——除非你想「自我了断」。

lines.en: : What is entrance level material? I would like to stay away from anything with gratuitous violence or premarital sex.
lines.zh: : 什么是入门级材料？我想避开任何有无端暴力或婚前性行为的东西。

lines.en: scene yasugenres19
: Okay. Well, that rules out pretty much Rin’s entire collection, so...let’s see what else we can find laying around here.
lines.zh: : 好。那基本排除了 Rin 的整个收藏，所以……我们看看这儿还能翻出点什么。

lines.en: scene black
Molly and Futaba begin sorting through a few boxes while Yasu and I stand awkwardly in the corner, occasionally making eye contact- which may or may not be a sin according to her religion.
lines.zh: Molly 和 Futaba 开始翻几个箱子，而我和 Yasu 尴尬地站在角落，偶尔对上眼神——按她的宗教，那也许是、也许不是一种罪。

lines.en: I take the fact that she hasn’t spontaneously burst into a fit of tears to be a good sign, though, and let the awkward silence bridge the ever growing gap between us in the form of a temporary respite.
lines.zh: 不过她没有突然哭起来，我把这当成好兆头，并让这份尴尬的沉默充当一座桥，暂时架在我们之间那道越来越大的裂缝上。

lines.en: There’s still a great deal I don’t understand about her. Particularly the parts where she vanishes and leaves me alone at a table full of eggs, but things like that can wait until another day.
lines.zh: 她身上还有太多我不理解的地方。尤其是她会消失、把我一个人留在一桌鸡蛋旁那部分——不过那种事可以改天再说。

lines.en: For now, I’m just interested in seeing how she functions as a normal misfit girl, trying to fit in with people who genuinely want her to fit in-
lines.zh: 眼下，我只是有兴趣看看她作为一个「格格不入的普通女孩」是怎么运转的——试着融入一群真心希望她融入的人——

lines.en: And likely making everyone very uncomfortable in the process.
lines.zh: 并且很可能在这个过程中让每个人都极不舒服。

lines.en: scene yasugenres20
: Question! How gratuitous is “gratuitous violence?”
lines.zh: : 提问！「无端暴力」到底有多无端？

lines.en: : Can there be any violence at all? Because there are a lot of very accessible shonen manga that serve as an awesome gateway to the world of anime!
lines.zh: : 可以有一点暴力吗？因为有很多非常亲民的少年漫画，是通往动漫世界超棒的入门！

lines.en: : Umm...
scene yasugenres21
: Is all romance off the table as well? Or just romantic series with...um...premarital sex?...
lines.zh: : 所有恋爱题材也都排除吗？还是只排除有……呃……婚前性行为的恋爱作品？……

lines.en: : Because romantic subplots are essentially impossible to avoid in fiction, but there are a lot of fantasy series I enjoy that barely focus on it at all. And I think you’d love those!
lines.zh: : 因为恋爱支线在虚构作品里基本躲不开，但我喜欢的好些奇幻系列几乎不怎么碰它。我觉得你会爱死那些！

lines.en: : That...sounds like it might be okay...
lines.zh: : 那……听起来也许还行……

lines.en: : What about this?
lines.zh: : 那这个呢？

lines.en: I pick up the first book I see on top of a stack that looks relatively safe for work. And after skimming through the pages, I can say with utmost certainty that there is no premarital sex or gratuitous violence.
lines.zh: 我从一摞看起来相对「安全」的书最上面拿起第一本。翻过几页之后，我可以极其确定地说：里面没有婚前性行为，也没有无端暴力。

lines.en: It doesn’t really seem like there’s much of anything, though.
lines.zh: 不过似乎也没什么别的东西。

lines.en: It’s just...people talking.
lines.zh: 就只是……人们在说话。

lines.en: scene yasugenres22
: Whatcha got there, Sir? You digging into Ami’s slice of life pile?
lines.zh: : 您拿到什么了，先生？在挖 Ami 的日常系那堆？

lines.en: : Oh, I think something like that might be good for Yasu as well.
lines.zh: : 哦，我想那类对 Yasu 可能也不错。

lines.en: : Slice of life?
lines.zh: : 日常系？

lines.en: : I guess that’s what I’m holding, sure.
lines.zh: : 我想我手里拿的就是，没错。

lines.en: : It’s not violent?
lines.zh: : 它不暴力吗？

lines.en: scene yasugenres23
: Not that kind of slice, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 不是那种「切片」，Yasu。

lines.en: : In fact, here’s a little weebnote for you.
lines.zh: : 事实上，给你一个小死宅注。

lines.en: : Slice of life is a genre of anime and manga that focuses primarily on the lives of the characters in the story and less on a unified and major coherent plotline.
lines.zh: : 日常系是动漫和漫画的一种类型，主要聚焦故事中角色的生活，而不是统一、连贯的主线剧情。

lines.en: : That’s not to say there’s never any sort of plot at all, though. A lot of SoL series can blend in action and drama without ever abandoning their roots.
lines.zh: : 不过这不代表完全没有剧情。很多日常系作品能融入动作和戏剧元素，却从不背离自己的根基。

lines.en: : It’s something people tend to gravitate to after overloading themselves on more serious or action-packed series to sort of...unwind or reset.
lines.zh: : 人们通常在啃了太多严肃或动作向的作品之后，会倾向于转向它，算是一种……放松或重置。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean you can’t start there! And the one Sensei is holding would actually be a great one to go with since I’ve already finished it and can confirm there is zero sex at all!
lines.zh: : 但那不意味着你不能从它开始！而老师手里那本其实非常适合——因为我已经看完了，可以确认里面性内容为零！

lines.en: scene yasugenres24
: Hooray for no inappropriate content!
lines.zh: : 为没有不当内容欢呼！

lines.en: : Yeah! Hooray, I guess!
lines.zh: : 对！欢呼，我想！

lines.en: : I still think you should maybe consider shonen, though, since a lot of it nowadays is-
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得你也许该考虑少年漫画，因为现在好多——

lines.en: : Just let her have this, Molly.
lines.zh: : 就让她拿这本吧，Molly。

lines.en: scene black
I hand the book over to Yasu, who accepts it with the least creepy smile I have seen out of her thus far.
lines.zh: 我把书递给 Yasu，她用我迄今见过她露出的最不瘆人的微笑接了过去。

lines.en: She opens it up and begins reading very slowly, focusing for far too long on each and every page as if she’s taking in every last detail and every last line.
lines.zh: 她翻开书，读得非常慢，每一页都盯着看得太久，好像要把每一个细节、每一句话都吸进去。

lines.en: I’m sure that the artists involved would be happy to see this, but even then I think they’d believe it to be a tad excessive.
lines.zh: 我确信相关创作者看到会很高兴，不过即便如此，我想他们也会觉得这有点过头了。

lines.en: Molly and Futaba cross the room and take their places beside me like we’re some sort of proud, polyamorous couple watching our daughter take her first steps.
lines.zh: Molly 和 Futaba 穿过房间，在我两边站定，活像一对自豪的多角恋情侣，在看我们的女儿迈出第一步。

lines.en: I’m just a little disappointed because her steps are in a direction that I’m not particularly interested or invested in.
lines.zh: 我只是有点失望——因为她迈步的方向，我既不感兴趣、也不想投入。

lines.en: But hey, this is the first time I’ve ever seen a smile like that out of her.
lines.zh: 不过嘿，这是我第一次在她脸上看到那样的微笑。

lines.en: And it’s a lot more infectious than those that have been induced by her god.
lines.zh: 而且它比那些被她的神催出来的微笑，要有感染力得多。

lines.en: Yasu continues reading until the sun begins to set while the rest of us talk quietly amongst ourselves.
lines.zh: Yasu 一直读到太阳开始西沉，而我们其余人小声聊着天。

lines.en: When the final bell rings, Yasu closes her book and thanks all of us for our help.
lines.zh: 最后一道铃响时，Yasu 合上书，感谢了我们所有人的帮助。

lines.en: But not before grabbing three more books of what I expect and hope are the same genre.
lines.zh: 但在那之前，她又抓了三本——我估计、也希望是同一类型的书。

Yasu’s affection has increased to [yasu_love]!
lines.zh: Yasu 的好感度提升到了 [yasu_love]！
